name: The Inbetween
source:
A cosy cocktail bar isn't a bad place to wake up in...until you realise it's on the doorstep to Hell!

Welcome to 'The Inbetween' - the passing place for souls who knew how to have a good time before they shuffled their mortal coils.

You're served by the cheeky but charming owner, The Hellion - it seems he has a soft spot for you...and a proposal.

[From [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-inbetween]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
舒适的鸡尾酒吧并不是一个糟糕的醒来地方……直到你意识到它就在地狱的门口！

欢迎来到“中间”——那些知道如何在摆脱尘世束缚之前享受美好时光的灵魂的必经之地。

厚脸皮但迷人的老板恶人为你服务 - 看来他对你情有独钟……并且向你求婚。

[来自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-inbetween]itch.io[/url]]
